text:
Morgan Lee: Hey team — heads up, I need to swap primary for tonight. Flight delay, won't make the overnight window (22:00-06:00 UTC). Who can take primary? :airplane:

SRE-Bot: Pager triggered: inference-us-east 5xx spike (alert id a1f3). Current primary: Morgan Lee. Severity: P2. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/a1f3

Jamal Singh: I can take primary tonight if @Priya can be secondary. I'm EST, can cover 22:00-02:00 UTC then hand to Priya.

Priya Patel: I can be secondary and take handoff at 02:00 UTC. Quick question — any active incidents to handover?

Morgan Lee: Short context: since ~21:10 UTC we've seen sustained ~20% 5xx rate on inference-us-east. Suspected cause: GPU OOMs in one of the dedicated pools after a rollout. Traffic partially fell back to smaller model; latency doubled and customers see transient errors. Affected: 3 paying orgs (internal-corp), payments batch job, one external partner. I've already rolled back the last deploy and scaled down batch jobs.

Ravi Chen: Runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood/team-oncall/inference-5xx. Key commands: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=autoscaler`, and `pool-manager describe --pool us-east-dedicated-1`. Also check `redwoodctl cache status` for KV cache pressure.

Morgan Lee: Actions taken: rollback applied, batch jobs scaled, fallback routing enabled. Still seeing tail 5xx. Jamal — can you accept primary and run the quick health checks below?

Jamal Singh: Accepting primary. Will run checks and update.

Morgan Lee: Handoff checklist:
- Morgan: leave notes in incident channel and add to ticket (INC-4218)
- Jamal: run quick health checks and watch pager for 30m
- Priya: be ready to take 02:00 UTC takeover

Quick health checks (run these):
```
# check model-serving pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=model-serving
# recent 5xxs metric
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?m=5xx_rate&pool=us-east' | jq .
# routing config
redwoodctl routing get --pool us-east
```

Jamal Singh: Running checks now — one model-serving pod in CrashLoopBackOff (OOM) and autoscaler showing recent evictions. Restarting pod and monitoring.

SRE-Bot: Deploy bot: rollback completed for trial-deploy-3.0 by Morgan Lee at 21:34 UTC.

Priya Patel: Noted. I'll monitor dashboards at 02:00 and stand ready to take handoff. Can we also add Ops Rotation as a shadow secondary from 00:00-06:00 in case Jamal needs relief?

Ops Rotation: On standby and can shadow 00:00-06:00 UTC. Ping me if you need an earlier handoff.

Morgan Lee: Updated rotation calendar: https://calendar.redwood/internal/rotations — Jamal primary 22:00-02:00, Priya primary 02:00-06:00, Ops Rotation shadow 00:00-06:00. Final note: if 5xx persists >15 minutes escalate to SRE pager and follow runbook step 4 (scale pool + evict heavy batches).

Jamal Singh: Confirmed. I'll post a short incident summary after stabilization. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Thanks — good luck and ping if anything spikes.
